title: Board set: one cycle of a group's three-board screen

case.description: case the screen belongs to, e.g. example-bakeries

cycle.description: 1 for the first screen; each revision adds 1

revises.description: id of the board set of the previous cycle

reflected_from.description: element id of the position or reflexive position this cycle's reflexive exit was made from

profile.description: the method profile the record follows: a file in profiles/; it sets the boards, kinds, relation kinds and hints

run.description: the procedure run that produced the record

pack_sha256.description: sha256 of the `smd pack` output the run used

inputs.description: source id to the sha256 of the input files the run read

sample.description: run index when a procedure is run several times on one input

applied.description: ids of the patches applied to the record

boards.description: boards this record makes of its profile's board templates (`per_record`), e.g. one process board per working process; each is a board of its own

id.description: the board id elements name in `board`; no dot (a dot separates a board from its half)

template.description: a board template of the record's profile (`per_record: true`)

seen_from.description: element id of the position or reflexive position the board is seen from

unfolds.description: element id of what the board unfolds, e.g. the working process a process board idealises

cite.description: source id, optionally with an address: fp#t=00:23:45, gs#p=8

taxonomy_tags.description: taxonomy id to the values the item takes in it, checked against the taxonomy file

route.description: the line of work the item came from: the SMD line or the TRIZ line

scheme.description: free id of the named scheme, next to 'of' (the block of that scheme)

modality.description: модальность фактического or должного: what is, or what should be made (GP-Guide11 ¶7)

voice.description: whose words these are; no speaker names

scheme_block.description: block of a named structural-functional scheme that is missing or problematic (GP-PP)

board.description: a board of the record's profile, e.g. od, oo, s (profiles/)

half.description: required on a board with halves (the situation board), and only there

kind.description: a kind of the record's profile (profiles/)

short.description: screen label; the full label stays in texts and tables

fillers.description: actors (forms) that can occupy this role; positions, places for others and gaps only (docs/method/roles-and-actors.md)

detail.description: a table behind the element, shown in details and tables, never on the boards

keys.description: column name to taxonomy id; the column's cells are checked against the taxonomy

of.description: gaps only: the scheme block the gap is missing from

scheme.description: gaps only: the named scheme 'of' refers to

seen_from.description: element id of the position or reflexive position this item is seen from

stance.description: positions and reflexive positions only: внутренняя (a place in the structure), рефлексивная or внешняя позиция (GP-Guide11 ¶35-36)

acts_as.description: positions only: the place the position takes: организатор, руководитель, управляющий, политик, функционер (GP-Guide10 ¶7; GP-T5 pp. 242-243)

arises_from.description: goals only: the breakdown the goal answers: gaps, facts, difficulty or problem theses (GP-Guide11 ¶43)

goal_source.description: goals only: set at a breakdown (прокол), passed down under руководство, or the position's own (собственная) goal (GP-Guide11 ¶43; GP-Guide4 ¶12-15)

assigned_by.description: goals with goal_source assigned: the position or place for others that passed the goal down

nature.description: elements of an object board only: естественное, искусственное or both, the кентавр-объект (GP-STS; GP-T5 p. 252)

performed_by.description: functions only: the position or place for others that performs it

in.description: containers, e.g. a function inside a frame

voice_note.description: the voice text a migration replaced, kept as said

lens.description: id of the lens (lenses/<id>.md) whose questions produced the element

pace.description: years: the characteristic period of change of what the element stands for, e.g. a tier or a technology (Khaprov, podcast 28.10.2026)

vsm_system.description: kinds the profile flags vsm only (posts and positions of management-four-boards): the systems 1-5 of Beer's viable system model the place or position fills, one or several (BEER1972, Гл. 9-15)

of_whole.description: kinds the profile flags of_whole only (models of management-four-boards): true when the model is the firm's model of itself and its environment, the model Beer's system 4 keeps (BEER1972, Гл. 13)

written.description: kinds the profile flags of_whole only (models of management-four-boards): true when the model is written down and kept apart from the people who hold it, so that it stays when a holder leaves; a model of the whole with written: true gets no hint model-of-whole-one-filler (gate Г5б Б)

threshold.description: algedonic channels, and any element with red_line: true (gate ИИ1 Б): the limit of the index past which the channel signals, e.g. a stakeholder's red line (BEER1972, Гл. 17), or the red line's value, a threshold or yes/no that data check

recovery_time.description: algedonic channels only: days the unit has to bring the index back before the signal goes up (BEER1972, Гл. 17)

ai.description: roles (kinds the profile flags role; a gap only with of: position) and functions only: assists, people do the work with AI help; performs, AI does the work. A function without it takes the ai of the role in its performed_by (gate ИИ1 Б)

red_line.description: any element: true when it stands for a red line, a hard value a stakeholder set that is checked by data; an algedonic channel with a threshold is one without it; its value goes in line (threshold, free text, for old records). Not on kinds the profile flags light_off (notes). Read by the hints ai-decision-unanswered and red-line-without-value (gate ИИ1 Б)

line.description: red lines only (red_line: true, or an algedonic channel): the line's value, a corridor (min and/or max) or a yes/no (expect), and when it is in force (gate КЛ1 В)

expect.description: the yes/no line: what the data must show

since.description: when the line takes force; the record's date when absent

recovery_days.description: how long a value may stay outside before it counts as a breach

observed.description: elements with a line only: values the data gave, each with its date and the manifest id of its source (gate КЛ1 В)

geom.description: [x, y, w, h] as fractions of the screen; overrides automatic layout

move.description: structural move that produced this element (Zharnikov 2026, Invention as a Structural Operation, doi:10.5281/zenodo.21653102)

op.description: adjoin a dimension (alpha), rescale or requantize (rho), re-topologize or re-specify (tau), glue across domains (gamma)

from.description: elements (or, for a thesis, theses) the move was applied to

via.description: what the move works through: the added axis, the new grain, the changed link, or for glue the shared substructure or other domain

kind.description: a relation kind of the record's profile: shift, flow, produces, uses, belongs, opposes, refers, represents, other

carries.description: what a flow carries; the functional plan reads a payer as money in, an input as anything else in, a receiver as anything but money out

voice.description: who drew the link, e.g. AI
whose move between boards, e.g. AI in a solo session

short.description: screen text of the badge's K; the full text stays in texts and tables

by.description: position that qualified: organisers, methodologist, group, AI

voice.description: who wrote it, when not the position in 'by', e.g. AI drafting for the methodologist

thesis.description: SessionFlow thesis card (frame 03), with belt and kind from the classic method

status.description: the six SessionFlow labels, in order: Прозвучало в группе; Предположение участников; Предложение модератора / эксперта; Вариант формулировки от ИИ; Уточнено группой после записи; Оставляем открытым

belt.description: мД thought-action, М-К thought-communication, М pure thinking (GP1987)

feeds.description: board elements this thesis produced or changed

of.description: for a problem: the scheme block it is tied to

scheme.description: for a problem: the named scheme 'of' refers to

about.description: board elements the thesis reads or comments on without changing them

lens.description: id of the lens (lenses/<id>.md) behind the thesis

hypothesis.description: inter-module hypothesis: what we assume, how we test it, what we got, what it changes

voice.description: who formulated it: group, participant, AI (free text; AI, ai and ИИ all read as an AI voice)

lens.description: id of the lens behind the hypothesis

type.description: how the hypothesis is read (method review 31.10, gate М1 В): core of the programme, not tested directly; methodological product, tested for realizability in activity (GP1981); empirical claim, one claim falsified by a condition and threshold written before the field; estimate of a share, cost or frequency, an interval against a decision threshold; probe, a few interviews that produce hypotheses and test none; design choice or vision, not tested

rule.description: the pre-registered decision rule, a structured revise_if: the hypothesis is refuted when <metric> <op> <threshold> (gate Ф В)

metric.description: what is measured, e.g. «доля 55+»; a share when the threshold is strictly between 0 and 1

op.description: the refutation condition: refuted when the metric stands so to the threshold

n_min.description: the fewest cases the rule is read on

basis.description: where the threshold comes from: the decision it changes, a minimum effect, a source

observed.description: what the field gave for the rule: k cases of n in the artefact

changes.description: what the result changes on the boards

targets.description: board elements the hypothesis is about

artefacts.description: field artefacts the result rests on (source ids)

continuum_ref.description: an entry of an ontology's lives_in: an element of the record by id, or a short text
an entry of an ontology's lives_in: an element of the record by id, or a short text

ontology.description: ontological picture: valid for a set of positions and checked for realizability, not truth (GP1981)

valid_for.description: positions (or places for others, i.e. positions not yet taken) the picture is valid for

cooperation.description: cooperation element through which the common object is built

competes.description: what competes with what (Khaprov's ontology test)

lives_in.description: what the system lives in and must fit into: {id: <element id>} or {text: ...} (Khaprov, podcast 28.10.2026)

tempos.description: tempos the ontology assumes: what changes ({id: <element id>} or {text: ...}) and every how many years

text.description: what changes, when no element stands for it

horizon.description: years the ontology is expected to hold

covers.description: element ids the ontology's picture covers; compared with their pace against horizon

aspects.description: the object taken apart, aspect name to text, e.g. activity, carrier, ownership, management, separation

test.description: hypothesis that tests realizability in activity

lens.description: id of the lens behind the ontology record

signoff.description: human sign-off point; it must state the function it performs (Schukin's interface tax)

function.description: close a qualification; mark it partly answered; reopen it; accept or reject a structural move; accept a thesis as refined by the group; accept a field result as confirming or refuting a hypothesis; set the record verified

target.description: K id, element, thesis or hypothesis id; none for verify_record

by.description: the human or the group that signed; never an AI voice

difficulty.description: what failed in the previous cycle and triggered the reflexive exit
